cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(ms800-emu C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} -Wall -Wextra -O2")

find_package(SDL2 REQUIRED)

set(SOURCES
    src/main.c
    src/fake6502.c
    src/m114s.c
    src/acia6850.c
    src/bus.c
    src/ui_panel.c
)

# Panel artwork is compiled into the binary (generated by tools/gen_panel_art.py).
set(EMBED_DIR ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/embedded)
set(EMBEDDED)
foreach(art panel sprites)
    set(out ${EMBED_DIR}/${art}_bmp.c)
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${out}
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${EMBED_DIR}
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DIN=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/${art}.bmp
                -DOUT=${out} -DNAME=${art}_bmp -P ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/embed.cmake
        DEPENDS ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/${art}.bmp ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/embed.cmake
        COMMENT "Embedding assets/${art}.bmp"
        VERBATIM)
    list(APPEND EMBEDDED ${out})
endforeach()

add_executable(ms800-emu ${SOURCES} ${EMBEDDED})

target_include_directories(ms800-emu PRIVATE
    src
    ${SDL2_INCLUDE_DIRS}
)

target_link_libraries(ms800-emu PRIVATE
    ${SDL2_LIBRARIES}
    m
)

if(APPLE)
    target_link_libraries(ms800-emu PRIVATE
        "-framework CoreMIDI"
        "-framework CoreFoundation"
    )
    target_compile_definitions(ms800-emu PRIVATE __APPLE__)
endif()

add_custom_command(TARGET ms800-emu POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/roms
        $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:ms800-emu>/roms
    COMMENT "Copying ROMs to build directory"
)
